tasks.description: In docs/docs/flink-writes.md, document the sink write options for post-commit table maintenance: the new `flink-maintenance.rewrite.enabled` (with deprecated alias `compaction-enabled`), `flink-maintenance.expire-snapshots.enabled`, and `flink-maintenance.delete-orphan-files.enabled` options, and note that the old `compactMode` flag is replaced by `tableMaintenanceEnabled` and that multiple maintenance tasks can be registered via the IcebergSink builder `maintenance(...)` method.

In docs/docs/flink-maintenance.md, confirm/update the Delete Orphan Files Configuration table so `flink-maintenance.delete-orphan-files.use-prefix-listing` default is documented as `true` (changed from `false`), and ensure the Enable Flags table reflects the new option keys and the deprecated `compaction-enabled` alias.
